gloss: to launch; to shoot up; to hold a wrap-up party

definitions.explanation: To send something up into the air, such as fireworks or a rocket.

definitions.gloss: to hold a wrap-up party; to celebrate completion
definitions.explanation: To hold a celebration or party at the end of a project, event, or performance.

examples.japanese: {花火|はなび}を{打|う}ち{上|あ}げる。
ロケットを{打|う}ち{上|あ}げることに{成功|せいこう}した。
{人工衛星|じんこうえいせい}を{打|う}ち{上|あ}げる{計画|けいかく}が{進|すす}んでいる。
examples.english: Plans to launch an artificial satellite are underway.

examples.japanese: {夏祭|なつまつ}りで{何千発|なんぜんぱつ}もの{花火|はなび}が{打|う}ち{上|あ}げられた。
examples.english: Thousands of fireworks were launched at the summer festival.

examples.japanese: {新|あたら}しい{観測|かんそく}{衛星|えいせい}が{来月|らいげつ}{打|う}ち{上|あ}げられる{予定|よてい}で、{天気予報|てんきよほう}の{精度|せいど}が{上|あ}がると{期待|きたい}されている。
examples.english: A new observation satellite is scheduled to launch next month, and it is expected to improve weather forecast accuracy.
Let's go to the wrap-up party.

examples.japanese: プロジェクトが{終|お}わったから{打|う}ち{上|あ}げをしよう。
examples.english: The project is finished, so let's have a wrap-up party.

examples.japanese: {公演|こうえん}の{後|あと}、{出演者|しゅつえんしゃ}とスタッフで{打|う}ち{上|あ}げをした。
examples.english: After the performance, the cast and staff had a wrap-up party.

examples.japanese: {試合|しあい}に{勝|か}って、チーム{全員|ぜんいん}で{打|う}ち{上|あ}げをした。
examples.english: We won the match and the whole team had a celebration party.

examples.japanese: {撮影|さつえい}が{無事|ぶじ}に{終|お}わり、{監督|かんとく}が{盛大|せいだい}な{打|う}ち{上|あ}げを{開|ひら}いてくれた。
examples.english: Filming wrapped up safely, and the director threw a grand wrap-up party for us.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{打|う}ち{上|あ}げる → {打|う}ち{上|あ}げない (negative)
・{打|う}ち{上|あ}げる → {打|う}ち{上|あ}げて (te-form)
・{打|う}ち{上|あ}げる → {打|う}ち{上|あ}げた (past)

FORMATION:
Compound verb: {打|う}つ (to strike, to hit) + {上|あ}げる (to raise)

RELATED EXPRESSIONS:
・{打|う}ち{上|あ}げ - noun form (launch; wrap-up party)
・{打|う}ち{上|あ}げ{花火|はなび} - fireworks that are launched into the sky
・{打|う}ち{上|あ}げパーティー - wrap-up party

USAGE:
Sense 2 (celebration) is very common in Japanese work culture:
・{公演|こうえん}の{打|う}ち{上|あ}げ (post-performance party)
・{撮影|さつえい}の{打|う}ち{上|あ}げ (filming wrap party)
